name: telelean
description: Your mental model as a board of ASSUMPTION / DERIVATION / GOAL cards, backed by Lean 4 (personal prototype)

untrustedWorkspaces.description: telelean builds and checks the model folder with Lean, which can run code while it compiles.

telelean.memory.capGiB.markdownDescription: Memory cap in GiB for each sandboxed Lean build and check (systemd `MemoryMax`, no swap). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.memory.minAvailableGiB.markdownDescription: Lean refreshes pause ("paused: low memory") while the system's available memory (`MemAvailable`) is below this many GiB. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.refresh.enabled.markdownDescription: Check the model with Lean (`lake build` plus a generated check file) while its board is open. Off: the board runs in syntactic mode. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.refresh.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long telelean waits after a save (or its own edit) before it re-checks the model with Lean, in milliseconds. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.git.snapshotRefs.markdownDescription: Record every change telelean makes as a private git ref (`refs/telelean/…`) in the model folder's own repository: the board's History dropdown, Revert and the storage counter. Never touches your branches, staging area or hooks. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.git.path.markdownDescription: The `git` executable telelean uses for history snapshots (default: `git` on the PATH). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.model.markdownDescription: The Claude model a "These suffice" run uses (passed to your Claude Code as `--model`, e.g. `claude-opus-5-5` or an alias such as `opus`). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.effort.markdownDescription: How much effort Claude spends per response in a run (Claude Code's `--effort`). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.claude.path.markdownDescription: The Claude Code executable for runs. Empty: telelean finds it (the VS Code Claude Code extension's binary, then `claude` on the PATH, then `~/.local/bin/claude`). When set it must work: telelean does not fall back to another one. Version 2.1.295 or newer. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.maxTurns.markdownDescription: Most model responses Claude may use in one round of a run (the first round, each Feedback, each adopted suggestion). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.maxChecks.markdownDescription: Most Lean checks Claude may ask for in one round of a run (`check_lean`, `freeze_statements` and each suggested premise count one). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.maxAgentMinutes.markdownDescription: Most minutes Claude may work in one round of a run; the time it waits for your answers does not count. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.leanJobSeconds.markdownDescription: Time limit in seconds of each Lean job of a run (build, check, comparator). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.maxGateAttempts.markdownDescription: How often Claude may claim to be finished in one round before telelean stops it: after each failed check it asks Claude to retry with the exact failure; after the last one it tells you and reverts Claude's working copy to the last state that passed. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.keepRuns.markdownDescription: How many finished runs per model folder telelean keeps (their working copies and transcripts, in VS Code's storage for telelean). Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

enumDescriptions: The first message to Claude lists every card of the subject.
The first message lists only the cards whose statements the target or a selected premise mentions.
telelean.run.contextScope.markdownDescription: Which other cards of the subject the first message of a run lists as context. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

telelean.run.reuseLeanBuild.markdownDescription: Start each run's working copy from your model's Lean build (`.lake/build`) instead of building it from scratch, but only when the board's last Lean check succeeded and nothing has written that build since (otherwise the run builds from scratch anyway); Lake still rebuilds whatever in the copy does not match the run's files. Off: every run builds its working copy from scratch, a second or two for a small model. Takes effect after a window reload (Developer: Reload Window).

colors.description: Colour of ASSUMPTION cards and of the Assumptions column on the telelean board.
Colour of DERIVATION cards and of the Derivations column on the telelean board.
Colour of GOAL cards and of the Goals column on the telelean board.
The aura around cards that are formalised in Lean.
Colour of the Vocabulary group and its items (types, predicates, constants) on the telelean board.
Highlight of the item an identifier in a card's Lean code refers to (click an identifier to highlight it).
